title: Bento-pane switcher flow and cost-lens prototype for console navigation
creator: Amaya Singh
description: Problem: The current console sidebar and workspace switcher are fragmented across flows (dashboards, rollouts, cost views). Users must jump between multiple panels to compare route-level metrics, rollout state, and cost breakdowns. This ticket proposes a unified 'bento-pane' approach: a compact grid of contextual panes in the left rail that surface primary destinations (Workspaces, Models, Routes, Rollouts, Cost Lenses) and expand into focused micro-views without full route navigation. Goals: 1) reduce perceived navigation friction, 2) expose cost telemetry and rollback actions inline, 3) provide keyboard and screen-reader friendly shortcuts, and 4) keep route URLs stable for analytics and deep linking. This prototype explores visual density, affordances for progressive reveal, and policies for when a pane becomes a full route (eg. deep editing vs quick glance).
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates expand/collapse behavior for 5 pane types: Workspace, Route List, Model Catalog, Rollout Panel, Cost Lens
Keyboard-only navigation sequence exists and is documented (tab + arrow nav + cmd-k to focus switcher)
Cost lens micro-visualization surfaces token-level cost and last-24h delta, with link to full cost dashboard
Rollout pane surfaces canary %, last evaluation and one-click rollback stub that triggers confirmation modal
Figma prototype passes accessibility contrast checks and includes aria-label annotations for all controls
